metadata.description: Salesforce development plugins for Claude Code: the vibe-force delivery harness plus curated Salesforce-authored domain plugins for the areas it deliberately does not cover.

plugins.name: vibe-force
plugins.description: Salesforce delivery harness: parallel agent waves, deep Salesforce and fflib skills, deterministic lifecycle hooks, local and post-deploy check gates.

plugins.name: dx-devops
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. DevOps Center pipelines and work items: pipeline and work-item administration, test-stage configuration, suite runs, failure analysis. Complements vibe-force wave 3, which deploys with the Salesforce CLI instead.

plugins.name: integration
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Generates integration metadata: Named Credentials, External Services, Connected and External Client Apps, Change Data Capture, platform event subscriptions. Pairs with the vibe-force skill sf-integration-patterns, which covers the Apex side.

plugins.name: platform-trust-security
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Shield Platform Encryption and Salesforce Archive: encrypted field configuration, key management, archive search and restore, retention analysis. Complements the vibe-force skills sf-security-model and sf-org-security-audit.

plugins.name: platform-observability
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Tracing metadata: EventSettings for TraceSpanEvent publication and Agentforce platform tracing into Data Cloud ingestion.

plugins.name: platform-lightning-widgets
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Custom Lightning Types and the widgets that render Agentforce action and MCP tool results.

plugins.name: experience-react
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. React UI Bundle apps: scaffold, generate pages and components, configure ui-bundle metadata, host on a Digital Experience site, deploy. Outside the vibe-force LWC slice.

plugins.name: experience-cms
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Experience Cloud CMS content: branding, content generation, content and media search.

plugins.name: mobile-development
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Native iOS and Android Mobile SDK apps: scaffolding, authentication, SmartStore and MobileSync offline, biometric login, embedded Agentforce.

plugins.name: service-engagement
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. Service Cloud digital engagement: messaging and chat channels, channel deployments, messaging site integration, Agentforce service channels.

plugins.name: commerce-b2b
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. B2B Commerce storefront customization with the Open Code storefront library: library integration, definition mapping, component replacement.

plugins.name: dx-isv-partner
plugins.description: Salesforce-authored. ISV and partner operations: App Analytics query requests, AppAnalyticsSettings, partner-offer preferences. Pairs with the vibe-force skill sf-packaging-release.
